'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals Cedrik Vanderhaegen LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2011 Luxembourg Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Cedrik Vanderhoeyden
* '''Deck name:''' NON-PROFIT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
